t: You're standing at Holy Trinity, a Roman Catholic church in Hammersmith, in the W6 postcode. The building is Grade II* listed, which puts it among the more significant historic buildings in the country. It was designed by William Wardell, who was born in 1823 and later became an Australian architect. He is best known for a series of landmark buildings in Melbourne and Sydney. So the man behind this London church went on to shape the skylines of Australian cities.
